GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , sat touch better Mid Field Two Wide 4 Lengths 1000m, Ridden Along between runners soon after Straightening Up , Just battled last 200m # held ground
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped on jumping. Travelled keenly in the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: jumped out ok. Settled Down Two Wide 8th, about 9 Lengths @ 1000m. Hooked Out Ridden Along still well back Straightening Up . passed a few in Straight . $8 Winner Led All The Way # home ok/1st led
Jumped okay, Restrained & Settled Down 4.5 Lengths on fence, little change to 4 Lengths rail turning, Held Up rounding turn then steered into cutaway, Made Some Ground to the line # battled on fairly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Change of tactics, to obtain cover if possible - settled outside the leader under no pressure. Bumped on jumping.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 2 Lengths on fence, Moved Up to 1 length Two Wide turning, dropped off in Straight # weakened noticeably
Jumped okay & Settled Down 5 Lengths 3 Wide , Drifted Back to 7.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, couldn't come on in straight. (Cross-over Nose Band FIRST TIME) # Wide early

Slow out 1.5 Lengths then hooked across and Settled Down 8 Lengths 3 Wide , in Two Wide by the 900m, Hooked Out Four Wide at 6650m, trailed 7 Lengths 3 Wide turning, improved marginally in Straight # slow out then Wide
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: After being slow to begin was shifted behind runners from the outside barrier.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 length Settled Down well back 6 lengths. well back turn. Held Ground # Not Sighted

Slow out 1 length and Settled Down 7 Lengths on fence, railed to 6 Lengths turning, hooked very Wide Straightening Up but couldn't come on in straight. (Lugging Bit OFF FIRST TIME, Unshod (Behind) OFF FIRST TIME) [Stewards: Underwent pre-race vet exam. Cleared to start.] # slow out/plugged
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Thereafter was bumped on jumping by a runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok faced breeze half off, pushed along a touch turn, took over Straightening Up , half clear 200m, headed passing 100m, kept on strong just no match once headed # breeze/kept finding
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: From a wide barrier worked forward, outside a slow early tempo, and settled outside the leader.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow away. Recovered & raced Worse than midfield on inside (5L from lead). Held Ground until pushed to quicken @ 500m. Pushed along Two Wide (5L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Two Wide @ 250m & held up @ 100m. Not ridden out late. # Inconclusive.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Approaching the 100m was steadied from the heels of the tiring runner and was not tested from that point.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow out 2 Lengths and Settled Down 5.5 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back to 8 Lengths Two Wide turning, Lost Ground in Straight # very slowly away
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin, losing approximately two lengths.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair settled last 10l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, plodded home # back/no threat
